'''Venaarian Cringe-Ale''' was a type of [[Ale/Legends|ale]] served at the [[Binary Bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. The ale was [[Color/Legends|yellow]] in color and had a bitter taste. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]], [[Sienn Sconn]], drank Venaarian Cringe-Ale at the Binary bar whilst planning how to steal a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] displayed there. He considered the drink expensive and upon drinking the ale his eyes were forced closed by the bitterness, however he considered the drink the price he had to pay for previous wild nights.<ref name="Ooak" />

==Behind the scenes==
Venaarian Cringe-Ale first appeared in the story [[One of a Kind (short story)|''One of a kind'']] which was written by [[Paul Danner]] and first published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5]] in [[1995]] and then later made available as a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article in [[2004]].
